import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter out necessary columns and drop rows with missing values
data_filtered = data[['Rasse1Text', 'AlterVHundLang', 'AnzHunde']].dropna()

# Create a bar plot for the number of dogs by breed and age
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(data=data_filtered, x='Rasse1Text', y='AnzHunde', hue='AlterVHundLang', ci=None)

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Breed and Age in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.legend(title='Age of Dog', fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter out necessary columns and drop rows with missing values
data_filtered = data[['Rasse1Text', 'AlterVHundLang', 'AnzHunde']].dropna()

# Create a bar plot for the number of dogs by breed and age
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(data=data_filtered, x='Rasse1Text', y='AnzHunde', hue='AlterVHundLang', ci=None)

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Breed and Age in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.legend(title='Age of Dog', fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
